claims.text: OpenAI released o3 and o4-mini on April 16, 2025 [Source: ev-1].

witness.reason: claim figures absent from the evidence — untraced: 3, 4

claims.text: The launch signaled a strategic direction for frontier reasoning models characterized by the native integration of vision into the model architecture rather than bolting it on, as well as incorporating native tool use (such as web search and code interpreter) directly into the training process [Source: ev-1].

The release highlighted a new approach to compute efficiency through "budget forcing," which utilizes a fixed maximum thought budget with task-adaptive dynamic compute, allowing harder questions to require longer thinking times [Source: ev-1].
Strategically, the launch was an effort by OpenAI to defend the frontier of reasoning capabilities against competitors DeepSeek and Anthropic while GPT-5 had not yet shipped [Source: ev-1].
